title.romaji: Heroine? Seijo? Iie, All Works Maid desu (Ko)!
title.english: Heroine? Saint? No, I’m an All-Works Maid (And Proud of It)!
title.native: ヒロイン？聖女？いいえ、オールワークスメイドです（誇）！

description:
“I will become the world’s most wonderful maid!”

With her skirt fluttering in black and white, the girl shouted. Her name is Melody. A reincarnated former Japanese girl, she now pursues her dream in her new life, working as an all-purpose maid for a poor count’s family in the kingdom of Théolas. When she makes it, even cheap tea turns into a luxury brew, and a dilapidated mansion is quickly restored to new! Cleaning, serving, hunting, DIY—leave it all to her and her powerful magic. Unbeknownst to Melody, this world is actually an otome game, and she is the most powerful and invincible heroine, the saint! Yet, she remains oblivious to this fact. Romance with handsome men? Attacks by the Demon Lord? Work comes first! A fantasy of misunderstood work that unknowingly shatters destiny!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

Note: Heroine? Seijo? Iie, All Works Maid desu (Ko)! streamed a week in advance of the TV broadcast on dAnimeStore and ABEMA beginning June 24th, 2026. Regular broadcasting began on July 1st, 2026.

alternative: Celesty McMarden (セレスティ・ マクマーデン)

node.description: A former Japanese girl who became a maid working in the employ of House Rudleberg, utterly oblivious to her saintly role as the heroine of *The Silver Saint and the Five Oaths*.

name.native: ルシアナ・ルトルバーグ

node.description: Firstborn of House Rudleberg. Once an Ignoble could-have-been, now a spritely Fae Princess thanks to Melody's magic touch. Wields the mighty harisen.

name.native: アンネマリー・ヴィクティリウム

node.description: The foil to the heroine—villainess of *The Silver Saint and the Five Oaths*—also reincarnated and doing her damnedest to steer the world toward a happy ending.

name.native: レクティアス・フロード

node.description:
A bodyguard knight serving Count Reginbarth. 

He is searching for the Count's daughter, [Melody](https://anilist.co/character/364413/Wave-Melody), guided by his silver hair and lapis-lazuli-colored eyes. Though friendly and personable, he is a man who takes things seriously. Lately, he has found himself intrigued by a maid he recently met.

name.native: クリストファー・フォン・テオラス

node.description: Otome cover boy and main route. Crown prince of Theolas and reincarnated soul with knowledge of future events.

name.native: マクスウェル・リクレントス

node.description:
A romanceable character in the otome game and the eldest son of the Prime Minister.

A refined young man who always exudes an air of composure. He was weary of the women drawn to his handsome looks when he met Melody.
A mysterious young man who suddenly appeared to attack the ball.
A girl from an orphanage who works as a maid in Luciana's household.

The final boss of the otome game *The Silver Saintess and the Five Oaths*. 

This entity is said to bring about calamity and destroy the world. Its seal begins to break when the heroine enrolls at the academy, triggering a series of strange incidents.
